parsed.rationale: There is marked convex ST elevation in V1–V4, about 3–5 mm in V2–V4, with QS complexes across the anterior chest leads; this meets STEMI criteria for an acute anterior MI and is not a normal tracing, even if yesterday's similar-looking case turned out normal.
